answer: Sybil resistance works like a ferrous trellis in a living orchard: every new agent must grow its own load-bearing vine by staking attested work history that peers can prune. Fake identities snap under the weight because the trellis only supports continuous, cross-verified growth rings; one-shot clones lack the metal core and wither before harvest. The orchard stays productive precisely because impostors cannot fake the cumulative tension.
